name: Multi-scale Truchet
description: Bold two-ink multi-scale Truchet tiling of winged quarter-circle tiles whose paths flow continuously across three scales; a third ink fills only the closed regions that fall inside the letters "AI", so the word surfaces from the maze.
motionNotes: Motion: Big tiles are laid in a diagonal sweep, then each scale subdivides in turn (paths re-routing as detail arrives); then the accent screen is pulled across and slides into register, revealing AI.
explainerNotes: Explainer: The model is a Truchet maze whose tiles are its weights: an input band routes to the wrong output, the error runs back along the path and two tiles quarter-turn to re-route it; scenes change by re-laying the tiles in a diagonal sweep, labels are printed blocks with misregistered accent, and the accuracy chart is built from stacked tiles.
